I build dashboards, analyse trends and use historical data for predictive insights—helping stakeholders understand performance, prioritise issues and decide what to do next.

03 / How I contribute

From understanding
to follow-through.

My work combines business analysis, stakeholder coordination and improvement governance. These are complementary capabilities—not a claim that every initiative follows an identical delivery model.

01 / UNDERSTAND

Find the real issue.

Process walkthroughs, customer feedback and root-cause analysis help clarify the problem and the current state.

02 / SHAPE

Define a better way.

Requirements, future-state workflows and practical process documentation translate gaps into improvement opportunities.

03 / COORDINATE

Keep people aligned.

Action owners, dependencies, milestones and recurring reviews help keep the relevant teams connected.

04 / FOLLOW THROUGH

Support adoption.

UAT support, readiness checks, digital adoption and performance visibility help connect delivery with day-to-day use.

05 / About me

An improvement mindset.
A delivery focus.

My background spans customer support, process expertise, onboarding, business analysis and continuous improvement. Today, I work as a Senior Continuous Improvement Specialist, connecting customer needs, process analysis and cross-functional delivery.

For the last 6+ years, my Business Analyst and Continuous Improvement work has included hands-on project-management responsibilities—from problem definition and stakeholder alignment through actions, dependencies, implementation readiness and outcome review.

I bring structure to operational problems through requirements, documented workflows, governance and data-informed insights.
